main_body: Large leaf canopy mass in several greens, with a dark brown trunk and roots at the bottom
top_band: Organic canopy: light green clumps (rows ~2-14) over mid and dark green volume; no flat rim or single band, and the trunk is visible below the canopy (rows 60-78)
evidence: The canopy is a rounded organic volume lit from above: lighter leaf clumps sit on the upper part and darker greens and shadow gaps show lower down, with the trunk and roots below. It shows no flat elevation, no receding side face and no thin rim. Reads as a tree in the 3/4 view, similar to the references. Dark canopy underside above the trunk gives a shaded lower mass.

style.evidence: The canopy uses only about 3 greens (light, mid, dark) in dithered clumps, against the 5 or so steps of the references. The outline is a near-black line around the canopy silhouette with little green tint, which gives a sticker look compared with the references' dark-green edges. The trunk is a flat dark brown mass with little grain and only a few highlight pixels. The leaf clump texture is present but coarse and noisy, and the leaves lack the per-leaf highlights and varied tones that the references carry. Overall thinner and flatter than the references.
